json_patch.value: Fix: [wrangler] Add --source-namespace and --source-repo-name for artifacts.repo queue subscriptions. Target files: .changeset/artifacts-repo-subscription-flags.md, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/queues/queues-subscription.test.ts, packages/wrangler/src/queues/cli/commands/subscription/create.ts. `wrangler queues subscription create --source artifacts.repo` could never succeed. The Event Subscriptions API requires `source.namespace` and `source.repo_name` for this source ("Validation error: Required at "source.namespace"... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16051)
